answerBlock.what: Electric 10 Series Concrete Pump is a compact electric concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Catalogue parameters: 15 kW motor, 21 m³/h theoretical output, 23 MPa, 25 m horizontal, hopper 0.1 m³, 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm, 400 kg, aggregate 2 cm and below. It is not Electric 15, not Electric 40 and not B500S-83D.
answerBlock.who: Buyers matching a 400 kg compact electric unit to 25 m horizontal pipeline and 2 cm aggregate, with 15 kW on site.
factors: 15 kW / 400 kg / 25 m horizontal versus Electric 40 at 45 kW / 2300 kg / 120 m / 360 m
Theoretical output 21 m³/h is a printed cell, not Electric 40’s jobsite distance
Hopper 0.1 m³ versus Electric 20 at 0.25 m³
Alibaba SmartBuy mini-pump band 10–30 m³/h is a marketplace average, not this row

faqs.question: Is Electric 10 the same 21 m³/h machine as Electric 40?
faqs.answer: No. Both print 21 m³/h theoretical output. Electric 10 lists 15 kW, hopper 0.1 m³, 25 m horizontal and 400 kg. Electric 40 lists 45 kW, hopper 0.4 m³, fine-stone 120 m / 360 m and 2300 kg. Match the full printed row.

faqs.question: Does the Alibaba mini-pump 10–30 m³/h band replace this table?
faqs.answer: No. SmartBuy (20 November 2025) cites mini pumps at 10–30 m³/h as a marketplace type. Electric 10’s printed cells are 15 kW, 21 m³/h theoretical, 25 m horizontal and 400 kg. Use the Xingtai page.

faqs.question: Can Electric 10 replace B500S-83D for 5–16 mm sand?
faqs.answer: No. B500S-83D lists 7.5 kW, 5 m / 5 m, 280 kg and sand / small stone 5–16 mm, with no m³/h cell. Electric 10 lists aggregate 2 cm and below and 25 m horizontal. Open the matching product page.
